name: kineticPop
title: Kinetic Pop
description: High-saturation cobalt blue, vibrant marigold yellow, snappy elastic bouncing text, playful overshoot geometry, and dynamic pop motion.
do: Energize animations with snappy overshoot arrival and playful scale pops
Coordinate bold primary colors with punchy, high-contrast text layers
Stagger character animations or layered cards for rhythmic cascade
dont: Do not use dark muddy gloomy grays or dreary sepia tones
Avoid dull linear eases with zero anticipation or bounce
Never hide vibrant graphics behind heavy murky blur
